topography.project_purpose: Structural profile: 112 project-authored contract(s) across 3 chain(s); 30 ERC721 NFTs; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 5 functional families. Its contracts share 12 common project-authored base contract(s) (minterbase, customerc721metadata, standardtoken). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
